name: Minecraft: Java Edition
notes: Vanilla, Paper, Spigot, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, including 26.3's "System chat:" labels.

patterns.death: ^(?P<player>[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,32}) (?P<message>(?:was (?:speared|burned|slain|shot|killed|blown up|pricked|impaled|fireballed|struck|stung|obliterated|poked|skewered|squashed|squished|frozen|burnt|doomed|pummeled|roasted|smashed)|died|drowned|blew up|fell|hit the ground|burned|went up in flames|went off with a bang|walked into|tried to swim in lava|starved|suffocated|froze|withered|experienced kinetic energy|discovered the floor|didn't want to live|left the confines).*)$
patterns.advancement: {player} has made the advancement [{message}] || {player} has completed the challenge [{message}] || {player} has reached the goal [{message}]
